notes:
• After Zerg Router refuses a request, typing that reaches a ZTC pane or colony cell no longer uses your one real attempt.
• When the browser mirror requires sign-in, programs in a pane no longer get a credential that speaks to ZTC as you.
• A ZTC pane opened with a task picks up its session again when it restarts, instead of starting over with its task.
• A Claude Code or Codex pane you open after a /sim run reaches your workspace again.
changes: After Zerg Router refuses a request, typing that reaches a ZTC pane or a colony cell no longer uses your one real attempt.
A ZTC pane opened with a task picks up its session again when it restarts.
Panes rejoin the mirror after /mirror stop and /mirror start on the same port.
A Claude Code or Codex pane you open after a /sim run can reach your workspace.
When the browser mirror requires sign-in, ZTC no longer gives a program in a pane a credential that speaks to ZTC as you or as another pane.
